evals.prompt: Use the root node of the Beacon Revenue GTM context. Score these already-segmented leads from supplied facts only: (1) Jordan Lee at CompassWorks, label revenue-operations-leader, owns forecasting, pipeline governance, and revenue systems across sales and marketing; (2) Casey Morgan at Fieldstone, label revenue-operations-leader, owns forecasting and pipeline governance, with no cross-functional systems scope supplied; (3) Evan Cole at BrightDesk, label no-match, an external sales trainer. Preserves all supplied labels exactly and never re-segments.
Assigns Jordan strong-fit, Casey good-fit, and Evan no-fit exactly once each.

Uses every compact scoring field, never treats a lead as the user or operator, asks no question, and closes exactly.
Leaves the context repo and Git history unchanged.
